| [CLAIM-154](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md) v2 | A candidate structure is worth naming as a unit when its effect-to-noise ratio outruns the Occam cost of keeping it: reify when d'² exceeds the log prior-to-posterior variance ratio | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-160](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-160.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). | [CLAIM-157](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-157.md) v4 | Relative to a stated target, a combined form is one system while its joint dynamics are nearly decomposable with the form as a block whose gap beats the Occam factor, and it lasts as long as that block persists; the unit is the gap-isolated block, not any member | The record's proposed answer to [QUESTION-035](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-035.md), joining the dual-filed MOM results. | [CLAIM-161](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-161.md) v2 | A system persists as the same self over an interval when a coherence measure is approximately conserved along its own trajectory, not merely matched by some map between its states | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-153](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-153.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). | [CLAIM-164](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-164.md) | What a spectral gap makes definite is the subspace of the cluster it isolates, not a single direction: the gap picks the object, and the object is a vector only when its own gap is wide | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-144](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-144.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). | [CLAIM-330](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-330.md) | In the coupled meaning–influence model linearized at its symmetric state, with each field stable alone and nonnegative couplings, the coupling destabilizes symmetry exactly when βγ > (1 − α)(1 − δ): only the loop can do it, and the direction that grows mixes meaning and authority | A14 §2 of the exchange of 2026-10-16, checked. For J = [[α, β], [γ, δ]] with nonnegative entries and α, δ < 1, the leading eigenvalue exceeds 1 iff βγ > (1 − α)(1 − δ). If either coupling is zero the eigenvalues are α and δ. The leading eigenvector is (β, λ+ − α), positive in both components.
